items.title: Can BlackRock (BLK) Stay Cheap As Excess Returns Support Growth?
items.summary: BlackRock has delivered a strong 77.9% share price gain over the past three years, which puts a sharper spotlight on a basic question for you as an investor, whether that valuation is backed up by the returns the asset manager earns on the capital it deploys across its platform. The 77.9% return over three years has materially lifted expectations, which raises the issue of whether the underlying return on capital of BlackRock is strong enough to support that kind of re-rating. items.title: A Guide to Owning Bonds When They Are Selling Off
items.summary: A bond-market rout pushed the 10-year Treasury yield to the highest since 2007, but it doesn’t erase the value of fixed income in a diversified portfolio.  Over 80% of the global bond market now yields above 4%, according to BlackRock.  The asset manager says the average yield in a bond portfolio it tracks has more than doubled from five years earlier.

items.title: BLK vs. TROW: Which Asset Manager’s Dividend Actually Survives the Next Market Crash?
